title: W as frame and stage
slide_intent: Use an identity structure to organize content because the mark can guide reading as well as identify a sender.
strategic_value: Artist names and images placed on the W can let Whitney’s structure participate in exhibition communication.
demonstration: Two colored W sketches arrange Andy Warhol and Yayoi Kusama names along diagonals, with artwork reproductions within or beside the strokes.
practical_value: Explore whether the identity’s diagonals can support text and imagery without implying these preliminary arrangements are mandatory.

content_islands.name: Warhol sketch
content_islands.spec: Place the cyan Whitney W at left, with black names along the strokes and a small image below.

content_islands.name: Kusama sketch
content_islands.spec: Place the red Whitney W at right, with black artist lettering and a small artwork near the top.

reference_purposes.Intent: The essay explicitly explores the W as a frame, stage, border, arrow, connection and column.
reference_purposes.Application: The sketches place artist names and reproductions in relation to the W’s diagonals.
